notes.title: Scenarios section bug removed
notes.content:
Dear Gamers
An error, which has  never been encountered in our earlier updates, took place in the latest update and we learned that a Scenarios section appeared on the main menu, which we work on presently to bring diversification to the game, which is not playable yet, and which might inflict damage on the order of the Levels section.

We immediately interfered and rectified the situation by removing that section.
We apologize for the inconvenience and kindly ask you to update the game.

Thank you
